# Corrections to course materials

The instructor maintains this repository to distribute released course PDFs.
Students can report errors or suggest corrections through the course Microsoft
Teams space. Other readers can email [spadon@dal.ca](mailto:spadon@dal.ca).

Do not submit assessed work through issues or pull requests in this repository.
Submission and portfolio sharing follow the
[CSCI 3141 syllabus](../assets/planning/syllabus.pdf).
